meta.name: agent-ui
meta.description: Batteries-included agent component for React/Next.js from ui.inference.sh. One component with runtime, tools, streaming, approvals, and widgets built in. Capabilities: drop-in agent, human-in-the-loop, client-side tools, form filling. Use for: building AI chat interfaces, agentic UIs, SaaS copilots, assistants. Triggers: agent component, agent ui, chat agent, shadcn agent, react agent,  agentic ui, ai assistant ui, copilot ui, inference ui, human in the loop

copy.tagline: 用现成组件快速搭建 AI 对话与审批界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在 React 应用里快速加一个带审批和工具调用的 AI 聊天助手
copy.tagline_en: Build AI chat and approval interfaces with a ready-made React component
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a ready React component for AI chat with approvals.

howto.what: 启用后，当你需要 AI 聊天界面时，Claude 会给出一个 React/Next.js 的 agent 组件代码，内含运行时、工具、流式输出、人工审批和小部件，并支持客户端工具和表单填写。
howto.when: 当你说出“agent ui”、“chat agent”、“copilot ui”等关键词，或要求构建聊天界面、AI 助手时触发。

say.text: 用 agent-ui 生成一个带流式输出的聊天界面组件
say.note: Claude 会提供完整的组件代码和接入步骤。

say.text: 给 agent 加一个人工审批环节
say.note: Claude 会在组件配置中添加审批流程。

say.text: 让 agent 用客户端工具自动填写表单
say.note: Claude 会使用组件自带的表单填充功能。

howto.what_en: When enabled, if you need an AI chat interface, Claude provides a ready-made React/Next.js agent component code that includes runtime, tools, streaming, approvals, widgets, client-side tools, and form filling.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like 'agent ui', 'chat agent', 'copilot ui', etc., or ask to build a chat interface or AI assistant.

say_en.text: Use agent-ui to generate a chat interface component with streaming.
say_en.note: Claude returns the component code and setup steps.

say_en.text: Add a human approval step to the agent.
say_en.note: Claude adds an approval flow to the component.

say_en.text: Make the agent fill forms using client-side tools.
say_en.note: Claude uses the component's form-filling capability.
